findings.claim: XRP attributed exchange wallets total approximately 22.45B across 701 wallets and 24 venues.
findings.limitation: Not tradable float; includes omnibus/cold storage and non-customer reserves.

findings.claim: Same-wallet attributed balances are down approximately 161.1M XRP over seven days but only 12.7M over 30 days.
findings.limitation: Does not distinguish customer withdrawals from exchange wallet migration.

findings.claim: ETF/index holdings are approximately 1.1966B XRP with a reported weekly net flow of +3.39M XRP.
findings.limitation: GXRP flow gap, reconstructed rows and BITW rebalancing prevent treating the aggregate as clean cash inflow.

findings.claim: RLUSD is reported at $707.4M on XRPL and $1.71B on Ethereum.
findings.limitation: Canonical issuer and method are documented, but direct raw RPC was not retrieved in this run.

findings.claim: Circle USDC is natively available on XRPL under issuer rGm7WCVp9gb4jZHWTEtGUr4dd74z2XuWhE.
findings.limitation: Native availability does not establish material supply or XRP demand.

findings.claim: Circle Arc's founding validator cohort includes SBI Group; Arc uses USDC gas; Coinbase and Binance are listed exchange participants.
findings.limitation: Participation does not establish exclusive alignment or XRP flow.

findings.claim: Coinbase contributed x402 to Linux Foundation open governance; Circle, Ripple and t54 Labs are members; Ripple states XRPL x402 supports XRP and RLUSD.
findings.limitation: Shared standards governance is not a commercial partnership or guaranteed settlement volume.

findings.claim: T54 reports 14.83M XRPL x402 payment/settlement events and $48.3K cumulative USD value.
findings.limitation: Operator dashboard, event count is not proven to equal raw ledger transactions, and monetary value is small.

findings.claim: XRP Insights' x402 count, active-agent and top-merchant figures differ from the t54 primary dashboard and directory.
findings.limitation: Do not average provider values; raw invoice-to-ledger reconciliation is pending.

findings.claim: Circle says USDC represents 98.8% of agent-driven transaction volume.
findings.limitation: Denominator, time window, chain coverage and value-versus-count definition are not specified in the announcement.

findings.claim: SBI Group reports 60% voting-right ownership in SBI Ripple Asia; the Ripple profile does not establish direct XRP custody or use by SBI Ripple Asia.
findings.limitation: Do not attribute SBI Remit's XRP remittance activity to SBI Ripple Asia.

findings.claim: Project Trinity completed phase-two DvP operational verification using an SMBC-issued trust-beneficiary stablecoin with Progmat/Datachain cross-chain technology.
findings.limitation: Proof-of-concept only; the announcement does not identify XRP, RLUSD or USDC as the settlement asset.

findings.claim: SBI-affiliated entities have disclosed activity across XRP remittance, RLUSD/USDC distribution, Circle Arc and a separate SMBC stablecoin DvP proof-of-concept.
findings.limitation: This supports a multi-rail hypothesis but does not establish a unified corporate treasury or exclusive strategy.

findings.claim: The Japanese SBIC is Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.
findings.limitation: No verified affiliation with SBI Holdings or direct XRP relationship.

findings.claim: SBIC's ChatGPT/Copilot training was investee-company education, not an OpenAI or XRP partnership.
findings.limitation: Educational activity does not establish commercial integration.

findings.claim: SBI Ripple Asia is 60% voting-right owned by SBI Group and provides blockchain/DLT fintech solutions; Ripple's profile says SBI Ripple Asia does not handle XRP.
findings.limitation: Do not attribute SBI Remit's XRP usage to SBI Ripple Asia.

findings.claim: In SBI Remit's 2023 XRP-based corridor, SBI Remit sends the customer payment request, SBI VC Trade sends XRP in real time, and Tranglo processes the local payout to the beneficiary bank account.
findings.limitation: This confirms the announced operating roles at launch, not current throughput, XRP inventory or net accumulation.

findings.claim: SBI Ripple Asia sells RippleNet software services and explicitly states that it does not handle XRP.
findings.limitation: The XRP execution leg in the SBI Remit corridor is attributed to SBI VC Trade, not SBI Ripple Asia.

findings.claim: SBI Remit's company-wide cumulative remittances exceeded JPY 2.5T as of May 27, 2026; the total is not attributed to XRP or ODL.
findings.limitation: Exclude from XRP payment-volume features.

findings.claim: SBI Ripple Asia and DSRV announced a Japan-Korea payment/remittance feasibility study that contemplates XRPL as the ledger; this is not production throughput or direct XRP handling.
findings.limitation: Ripple's profile explicitly says SBI Ripple Asia does not handle XRP.

findings.claim: SBI Group and Startale joined Open Standard; the announcement lists Coinbase among 140+ participants and says JPYSC/OUSD interoperability is under consideration.
findings.limitation: Shared participation is not a bilateral Coinbase-SBI commercial agreement; experiment is not live; Circle is not identified in the cited announcement.

findings.claim: SBI Holdings and SMBC Group signed a capital/business alliance; SMBC agreed to a 5% capital participation in SBI Startale Marketing.
findings.limitation: Investment is in the JV, not SBI Holdings or an XRP issuer; future stablecoin use cases are not production volume.

findings.claim: SBI Group announced an approximately $50M investment agreement in Startale through a subsidiary.
findings.limitation: Closing and final ownership status were not independently verified.

findings.claim: JPYSC is issued by SBI Shinsei Trust and distributed by SBI VC Trade; initial access was account-limited and public-chain circulation was conditional.
findings.limitation: Do not count public-chain JPYSC supply or Arc settlement before onchain evidence.

findings.claim: SBI and Solana Foundation announced Strium and an SBI Solana Global plan for tokenized securities, RWA, stablecoins and 24/7 markets.
findings.limitation: No production throughput or XRP integration established.

findings.claim: SBI DigiTrust, NICE and DSRV announced a Japan-Korea stablecoin payment pilot; the asset is unspecified and completion was targeted for December 2026.
findings.limitation: Pilot only; no XRP asset or live settlement volume established.

findings.claim: SBI-affiliated entities participated in a DCJPY tokenized-deposit securities DvP proof-of-concept and a separate Ethereum/stablecoin public-chain securities distribution experiment.
findings.limitation: Separate projects; neither establishes XRP/RLUSD/USDC usage.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: SBI Group is building a multi-rail institutional strategy rather than choosing a single XRP or USDC network.
supporting_evidence: SBI Group is a Circle Arc founding validator and says it will leverage USDC and JPYSC.
SBI VC Trade distributes USDC and RLUSD in Japan.
SBI Remit sends customer payment requests in the XRP-enabled remittance corridor; SBI VC Trade is the entity that sends XRP in real time.
Project Trinity uses a separate SMBC-issued trust-beneficiary stablecoin for its DvP proof-of-concept.
disconfirming_or_missing: SBI Ripple Asia explicitly says it does not handle XRP.
No current throughput by rail is disclosed.
No evidence of exclusive commitment or net XRP accumulation from these initiatives.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Circle Arc may capture stablecoin-native payments, FX, lending and agentic settlement that might otherwise use XRPL.
supporting_evidence: Arc uses USDC as gas and has a large institutional/exchange/credit cohort.
Circle reports USDC at 98.8% of agent-driven transaction volume.
disconfirming_or_missing: Circle USDC is natively available on XRPL.
Coinbase, Circle, Ripple and t54 share x402 Foundation participation.
No chain-level flow evidence demonstrates displacement from XRPL.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: XRPL x402 is technically operational but current monetary settlement value is too small to establish material XRP market demand.
supporting_evidence: T54 reports about 14.83M payment/settlement events but only $48.3K cumulative value.
The facilitator supports both XRP and RLUSD, so event counts are not necessarily XRP-denominated.
disconfirming_or_missing: Raw ledger-level event-to-invoice reconciliation has not been independently completed.
The dashboard and third-party tracker disagree on counts and merchant/service totals.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: RLUSD's distribution is currently more Ethereum-centered than XRPL-centered.
supporting_evidence: XRP Insights reports $707.4M on XRPL versus $1.71B on Ethereum, approximately 29% versus 71%.
disconfirming_or_missing: Raw issuer gateway_balances and Ethereum totalSupply were not independently retrieved in this run.
The chain split has changed historically; a single snapshot does not establish durable migration or redemption causality.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The seven-day decline in attributed exchange wallets may reflect XRP moving to self-custody or other venues.
supporting_evidence: Same-wallet attributed balances declined approximately 161.1M XRP over seven days.
disconfirming_or_missing: Thirty-day same-wallet change is only about -12.7M XRP.
Unattributed wallet transfers, internal cold-wallet movements and coverage changes prevent a customer-withdrawal conclusion.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Positive weekly ETF/index flows despite a tracker-estimated cost basis above spot may indicate persistent allocation interest.
supporting_evidence: Tracker reports +3.39M XRP net weekly flow and approximately 1.1966B XRP holdings.
disconfirming_or_missing: Weekly flow is small relative to holdings.
GXRP flows are excluded and some historical rows are reconstructed.
The estimated average cost is not issuer-reported investor cost basis.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: SBI-affiliated entities are testing several distinct settlement rails—XRP remittance, RLUSD/USDC distribution and SMBC-stablecoin DvP—rather than making a single-network commitment.
supporting_evidence: SBI Remit has an XRP bridge-asset remittance service in selected corridors.
SBI VC Trade distributes RLUSD and USDC in Japan.
SBI Group is a Circle Arc founding validator and says it intends to leverage USDC and JPYSC.
Project Trinity used an SMBC-issued trust-beneficiary stablecoin with Progmat/Datachain cross-chain technology.
disconfirming_or_missing: Project Trinity is a proof-of-concept/operational verification, not evidence of commercial throughput.
No current transaction volume, asset allocation or balance-sheet commitment by rail is disclosed.
No evidence establishes that these initiatives share one treasury or settlement strategy.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: SBI Group is assembling a diversified institutional onchain-finance portfolio across XRP/ODL, RLUSD, USDC/Arc, JPYSC/OUSD, SMBC stablecoin DvP, DCJPY, Solana/Strium, Ethereum tokenized securities and XRPL research.
supporting_evidence: SBI VC Trade is the XRP execution leg in the SBI Remit corridor and also distributes RLUSD, USDC and JPYSC.
SBI Group is a Circle Arc founding validator and says it intends to leverage USDC/JPYSC.
SBI-affiliated participants completed Project Trinity using an SMBC-issued stablecoin for security-token DvP testing.
SBI announced JPYSC/OUSD interoperability research with Open Standard, which lists Coinbase among participants.
SBI and Solana Foundation announced Strium and SBI Solana Global plans.
SBI Ripple Asia and DSRV announced an XRPL feasibility study, while Ripple states SBI Ripple Asia does not handle XRP.
disconfirming_or_missing: Most of the non-XRP initiatives are pilots, feasibility studies, planned infrastructure or account-limited distribution rather than demonstrated production volume.
No unified SBI treasury, asset allocation or exclusive settlement strategy is disclosed.
No current XRP corridor throughput or net XRP inventory is disclosed.

source_independence.rule: Same-publisher dashboard and company press release are not independent corroboration; provider values remain separate until raw on-chain reconciliation. SBI Project Trinity and SBI Ripple Asia claims are sourced to separate official SBI/Ripple company pages; no XRP edge is inferred from corporate names alone.

corrections.reason: No matching source ID or primary evidence was found for that exact edge; the official SBI/Ripple profiles establish ownership and fintech services, not direct XRP custody/use.
corrections.replacement: SBI Group -> SBI Ripple Asia 60% voting rights; SBI Ripple Asia -> RippleNet/FinTech services with no direct XRP use admitted.

corrections.correction: Added Project Trinity as a separate SBI-affiliated DvP proof-of-concept using an SMBC-issued trust-beneficiary stablecoin.
corrections.reason: Official SBI Holdings announcement identifies the settlement asset and technology providers; it does not identify XRP, RLUSD or USDC.
